releaseNotes: Playlists & Queue. Adds persistent local playlists with create, rename, delete, play, shuffle, ordered track editing, and add-song/add-album/add-artist actions. Song long-press now includes Play next, Add to queue, and Add to playlist. Adds a live Up Next screen with jump-to-track, move up/down, remove, clear after current, and Save queue as playlist. Playlist and queue state reference existing MediaStore songs only; audio files are not duplicated, moved, or modified. Preserves Shadow Realm filtering, metadata editing/auto-fill, Bluetooth/MediaSession album artwork, shuffle/repeat, safe-area UI, changelog export, and the hardened in-app updater.
